messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: increment log prob in transformed parameters block?
parts:
My original intention was to allow increment_log_prob in
the transformed parameters block to implement Jacobians
in the right place. But then I implemented it to disallow
those increments.

QUESTION: Should we allow increment_log_prob (and whatever
it morphs into) in the transformed parameters block?

There's an old issue that Kevin Van Horn just resurfaced:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/889

I updated the next manual issue so that the doc will be right.

- Bob
